CRP.notes: No retail dairy cream powder (spray-dried cream) found in Japan. Under the Japanese milk ordinance 'クリームパウダー' is an industrial dairy category (milk fat ≥ 50 %) sold B2B; consumer baking shops list only custard/whipped-topping mixes and non-dairy creaming powders, which the protocol rejects. WebSearch budget of the session was exhausted during this country (200/200 calls shared by parallel agents), so later discovery used retailers' own on-site search only.
